Package appDomain

Class XMLParser

java.lang.Object
appDomain.XMLParser
public class XMLParser extends Object
This program is designed to validate the structure of an XML document. It reads an XML file, identifies any structural issues such as mismatched tags, invalid close tags, or extra unmatched tags, and logs the errors into different categories. The program supports nested XML structures and provides detailed debugging information for developers. It also handles both resource files and absolute file paths.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Main entry point for the XMLParser application. Reads an XML file, validates it, and prints an error log for any issues found.
      Parameters:
      args - Command-line arguments, expecting a single argument: the XML file path.

    • getReader

      private static BufferedReader getReader(String filename) throws IOException
      Opens the specified file and returns a BufferedReader for reading its contents. Supports both resource files and absolute file paths.
      Parameters:

      BufferedReader for the specified file.

    • validateXML

      private static void validateXML(BufferedReader reader, QueueADT<String> invalidCloseTagQueue, QueueADT<String> errorQueue, QueueADT<String> extrasQueue, int rootLineNumber, boolean rootEncountered) throws IOException
      Validates the structure of the provided XML document. Checks for mismatched, invalid, and extra tags, and logs errors to appropriate queues.
      Parameters:
      reader - BufferedReader for reading the XML document.
      invalidCloseTagQueue - Queue for storing invalid close tag errors.
      errorQueue - Queue for storing mismatched tag errors.
      extrasQueue - Queue for storing extra unmatched tag errors.
      rootLineNumber - Tracks the line number of the root tag.
      rootEncountered - Indicates whether the root tag has been encountered.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an error occurs while reading the file.

    • handleOpeningTag

      private static void handleOpeningTag(String rawTag, int lineNumber, QueueADT<String> errorQueue)
      Handles opening XML tags by pushing them onto the tag stack. If the tag is malformed, it logs an error.
      Parameters:
      rawTag - The raw tag string, including attributes.
      lineNumber - The line number where the tag was found.
      errorQueue - Queue for storing errors.

    • handleClosingTag

      private static void handleClosingTag(String rawTag, QueueADT<String> invalidCloseTagQueue, QueueADT<String> errorQueue, QueueADT<String> extrasQueue, int lineNumber)
      Handles closing XML tags by matching them with the top of the tag stack. Logs errors for unmatched, extra, or invalid tags.
      Parameters:
      rawTag - The raw closing tag string.
      invalidCloseTagQueue - Queue for storing invalid close tag errors.
      errorQueue - Queue for storing mismatched tag errors.
      extrasQueue - Queue for storing extra unmatched tag errors.
      lineNumber - The line number where the tag was found.
